name: Esplugues de Llobregat (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a white open right hand.
history: The official flag of Esplugues de Llobregat is an oblong flag of 2:3, blue, with a white open right hand 5/7 of the height and 1/4 of the length at the centre, the figure of the arms (blazoned in the Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 168 of 15 July 1967 as azure a dexter hand appaumy argent, the base or with four pales gules).

features.role: open right hand (dexter hand appaumy), 5/7 of the height
